skills.name: bootstrap
skills.description: Initial AI context setup — minimal CLAUDE.md and per-project AGENT.md from config + manifests.

skills.name: discover
skills.description: Deep codebase scan that augments CLAUDE.md and AGENT.md with architecture, patterns, and domain vocabulary.

skills.name: git-commit
skills.description: Stage and commit changes in worktrees with contextual messages.

skills.name: create-pr
skills.description: Push branch and open a PR via gh, populating title/description from commits and cross-repo context.

skills.name: update-pr
skills.description: Push commits and update an existing PR; report check and review state.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Fetch PR review comments and structure them for the agent to address.

skills.name: hookify-rules
skills.description: Generate .claude/hookify/ rules that enforce the read-only master pattern. Depends on the hookify plugin.

skills.name: md-to-gdoc
skills.description: Convert a local markdown file to a Google Doc in the user's Drive. Re-runs on the same file update the existing Doc — gdoc-id is tracked in the file's frontmatter. Requires per-user GCP OAuth setup (see the skill's README).
